title: Spinnerex
extract:
Spinnerex is  Oraxia's signature whip. Dealing  Toxin damage with high Status Chance, enemies tagged by Spinnerex and afflicted with  Toxin status have a chance to explode upon their death, spreading  Toxin status effects.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Toxin damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Coiling Viper and  Lashing Coil (Conclave only) stance.
Enemies hit by Spinnerex and then killed from any source have a 10% chance to explode for each stack of  Toxin status, spreading  Toxin damage.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
Spinnerex's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Isleweaver in Duviri. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest.
Alternatively, Spinnerex's blueprints can be purchased from Acrithis or Dominus Thrax in the Dormizone, using  Scuttler Husk awarded from Isleweaver. Each component blueprint requires 16  and the main blueprint requires 48 , totaling 96  Scuttler Husks for the complete set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Enemies hit by the Spinnerex within the past 5 seconds have a 10% chance to explode per  Toxin status effect on them when killed, dealing 480  Toxin damage in a 10 meter radius, with a forced  Toxin status effect.
Spinnerex does not need to deal the killing blow, nor apply the  Toxin status effects in order to trigger the effect.
Damage is affected by Melee damage buffs, Elemental buffs, and Faction damage buffs, but not by  Condition Overload.
Damage falls off with distance.
Explosions cannot perform critical hits, or apply modded status effects.
Explosions will cause an additional damage instance from  Garuda's  Seeking Talons,  Saryn's  Toxic Lash, and  Xaku's  Xata's Whisper.
Despite being her signature weapon,  Oraxia can never take full advantage of the Spinnerex due to her melee slot being blocked while using her ultimate ability,  Silken Stride.
